infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Ampora reads your calendar so it never schedules study sessions over your classes or existing events. It only reads — Ampora never adds, changes, or deletes anything on your calendar.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Ampora reads your calendar so it never schedules study sessions over your classes or existing events. It only reads — Ampora never adds, changes, or deletes anything on your calendar.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ampora uses your microphone for Brain dump, so you can speak your tasks instead of typing them. Recording only happens while you're actively using Brain dump.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Ampora turns your speech into text on your device for Brain dump, so what you say can be split into tasks. Nothing is recorded outside of Brain dump.
